summary: Tested /marcas filters (Grupo/Ejecutivo/Segmento) end to end with isolated TEST_377 data: 4 brands, 2 groups, 3 RIFs, created by a fixture and then deleted. Backend: GET /api/marcas and GET /api/grupos-economicos/{id}/marcas return segments[] (brand + RIF values, nulls dropped, sorted) and ejecutivos[{id,name}] (brand + RIF values, a name is used as the id when there is no id). All 781 real rows have the fields and the response takes about 0.5s. UI: every filter opens, the option, search and clear testids work, and the button text reads 'TEST_377 Grupo A' or 'Grupo: 2'. OR inside a filter, AND between filters and AND with the search all work. 'Sin asignar' works on all three filters: 679 brands with no group (678 real + Delta, and the Grupo column shows only '—'), 357 with no ejecutivo, 19 with no segment. The 'X de Y marcas' counter and brand-clear-filters (which also clears the search) work. With a filter active, select-all picks only the visible brands (2) and mass-actions-btn shows '2 seleccionados'. Removing a filter value cut the selection to 1, and adding it back did not re-select the hidden brand. Mass action Segmento=Corporativo on the 2 filtered brands processed 2 and changed only Alfa and Gamma; Beta and its RIF stayed the same. Regression: name search and expanding a brand to see its RIFs both work.

minor.issue: Existing inheritance behaviour, not new in this change, seen as a side effect. A segment mass action re-runs the full inheritance for each RIF, so a RIF whose ejecutivo is not listed in inherit_overrides and whose brand/group has no ejecutivo loses it (ejecutivo_user_id and ejecutivo_propietario become None). In the test, Gamma's RIF lost ejecutivo 'usr_test377_ej1', so Gamma then dropped out of the Ejecutivo filter. 1 of 472 real RIFs that have an ejecutivo is in this state. Consider propagating only the units the action touches.

issues: When the filters hide every brand the table only says 'No hay marcas.'; a message like 'Ninguna marca coincide con los filtros' would be clearer
Filter choices are not kept in the URL or in storage, so they are lost on reload (optional)

action_items: Optional: in mass actions, propagate only the fields that were changed, so RIF values not covered by overrides (for example ejecutivo) are not wiped
Optional: show a 'no matches' empty-state message when filters are active
critical_code_review_comments: Brands.jsx: the effect that reduces the selection uses a string signature (filterSig) with brands.length. That works, but if a reload returns the same number of brands with different contents, the selection is not trimmed. Low risk, because onDone already clears the selection.

Ejecutivo options mix user ids and bare names (when a RIF has ejecutivo_propietario but no ejecutivo_user_id), so the same person could appear twice if one place has an id and another does not. Real data has no such duplicates today.

A selected filter value that disappears from the options after a refetch stays active; the button shows only the label fallback and the user cannot untick it from the list (the clear button still works).
seed_data_creation: TEST_377 groups/brands/RIFs (brd_test377_*, grp_test377_*, cli_test377_*) were created by the fixture and removed by id afterwards. No real data was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: python tests/ui_fixture_iter377_brand_filters.py setup|cleanup. The pytest run needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. For UI login, inject session_token and user into localStorage (via /api/auth/me). Option testids are <filter>-option-<value>; for ejecutivos the value is the user id.
